name: display-scale-out-of-range
why: A scale outside 0.65-1.25 has to render clamped on both platforms. Whether the FILE keeps the original number is the separate question this case pins: normalising on read means opening a project rewrites a value the user never touched, and the original is gone.
divergence: macOS stores displayScale raw and clamps only at the point of use (DocScale.of), so 9.0 survives the round trip. Windows clamps inside coerceManifest, so the written file becomes 1.25.
